name: deputy-workforce-mcp
description: Find workforce coverage, workload, timesheet, availability, and staffing signals in Deputy.
long_description: A read-only MCP server for five grounded Deputy workforce workflows. Start with fictional fixture data, then connect a customer-owned Deputy installation when its API access is ready.

deputy_mode.title: Deputy mode
deputy_mode.description: Use fixture for fictional evaluation data or live for a Deputy installation.

deputy_base_url.title: Deputy installation URL
deputy_base_url.description: Customer-specific HTTPS Deputy URL. Leave empty in fixture mode.

deputy_access_token.title: Deputy access token
deputy_access_token.description: Customer-owned Deputy OAuth access token. Leave empty in fixture mode.

deputy_auth_scheme.title: Deputy authorization scheme
deputy_auth_scheme.description: Use Bearer unless the Deputy token issuer explicitly requires OAuth.
